_about: Journal entries (phase 10). One is chosen per event by the world's seed and the day. {a} and {b} are names or places, {n} a number, {nw} the number as a word, {Nw} the same capitalised, {day} the day. Rank: when a day has more than three entries, the lowest ranked go. Short, plain, past tense.

lines: Found this notebook in a drawer. I am going to write down what happens.
Started this today. Somebody should know what it was like.
I am writing this so I do not lose track of the days.
Day one, as far as I can tell. The street is quiet.
Got through the first night. Something tried the door around three.
The first night is over. I sat with my back to the wall until it was light.
Morning. They walked past the window twice in the night and did not stop.
First night done. I did not sleep much.
The lights went. It is very dark.
The power is gone. The fridge went quiet in the afternoon.
The whole street went dark at once. No power now.
The taps ran dry today. Every bottle counts now.
Nothing from the taps this morning. Just a cough of air.
The water stopped. I should have filled more.
I killed one today. It was wearing a wedding ring.
I killed one of them. It took longer than I thought it would.
The first one went down in the street. I had to sit down after.
Killed one today. It had been somebody's neighbour.
Bitten on the {a}. Cleaned it. We will see.
One of them got my {a}. I washed it and wrapped it.
A bite on the {a}. Not deep. I keep looking at it.
A {b} on the {a}. Cleaned it as best I could.
Hurt my {a} today. A {b}. It will slow me down.
Got a {b} on the {a}. Wrapped it and kept going.
Nailed boards across the {a}. Now I will hear them coming.
Boarded up the {a} today. It held when I leaned on it.
The {a} is boarded. The room is darker for it.
Finished the {a} today. The place feels more like mine.
Built a {a}. My hands are sore.
The {a} is done. I stood and looked at it for a while.
Met {a}. They would not come outside. We talked through the window.
Met {a} today. Neither of us trusted the other, but we talked.
Someone else is alive. {a}. I nearly cried.
Met {a}. They asked if I had seen anyone else.
Traded with {a}. I think I got the worse of it.
{a} traded with me. Neither of us said much.
Traded with {a} through the door.
{a} is dead. I keep thinking about it.
Lost {a} today.
{a} did not make it. I covered them with a sheet.
They went through in the night. I counted until I could not.
A crowd of them came down the street last night. I held my breath until it passed.
The crowd passed in the night. In the morning the street was full of their tracks.
There is a gate. Of course there is a gate.
Learned something about the way out today. I wrote it on the back page.
There is a way out. I read the note three times.
Somebody knew how to get out. I am trying to follow what they knew.
Found {a}'s grave. I stood there a while.
Found {a}'s grave. Day {n}, it said.
{a}'s grave. Someone was here before me and did not make it.
Found {a}'s grave today. I did not know what to say, so I said nothing.
Found {a} walking. I did what they would have wanted.
Put {a} down today. It was the right thing.
I laid {a} to rest. It did not feel like winning.
Set {a}'s stone with the others. Said the name out loud.
Carried {a}'s marker across town. It is in the cemetery now, in a row.
{a} has a stone now. Nobody else was going to do it.
Put {a}'s marker in the ground by the old stones. I did not stay long.
{Nw} days. I have stopped counting cans and started counting days.
{Nw} days. I did not think I would see this many.
Day {n}. Still here.
It is {a} now. The air changed overnight.
{A} came in today. I could smell it.
The season turned. It is {a}.
I sat on the stairs all afternoon.
I did not get up today until it was dark.
Nothing seemed worth doing today.
I could not stop shaking. I do not know why.
The writing stops here.
The writing stops in the middle of a line.
The last line is not finished.
I am very tired. I will write more tomorrow.
I could not get up today. I will try again in the morning.
My writing is getting worse. I will rest now.
I am not going on. I will stay here.
That is enough. I am going to sit down now.
I cannot do it any more. Whatever comes, it comes here.
I am staying. The house is warm enough and the door holds.
This is home now. I will not go any further.
I am going to stay here for good.
The gate opened. I went out.
Outside the wall now. I did not look back.
I am leaving by the gate. The road goes on past the trees.
